item.title: LeadX: Building a Full-Stack Web3 Compliance Sales Intelligence SaaS from 0 to 1
item.author: xifan.zou@outlook.com (Xifan)
item.description: As the sole technical lead, I built a Web3 compliance sales intelligence SaaS from 0 to 1—independently delivering the frontend, backend, database, and row-level security architecture, validating the product with real paying B2B customers, and developing practical lessons around technical decision-making and demand validation.
